master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Silas wiped his brow, the radiant heat of the forge baking his skin as he examined the latest billet. The sheer complexity of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea demanded precision, and he was determined to provide it. If he couldn't stabilize the magnetic alignment, the entire batch of ore would be ruined, a failure he refused to accept. He picked up the cooling metal, turning to find Hector entering the forge. 'Here,' Silas said, tossing the heavy billet to Hector. 'Don't drop it.'
